options.transcriptionOnlyHint: Subtitles will be in the video's source language
options.subtitleQualityHint: Turning on "Smart cue spotting" or "Whole-scene translation" also switches the transcription stage, so the transcription itself can come out different. "Translation style" only applies while "Whole-scene translation" is on, and "Improved burn-in" only changes the finished video. With all of them off the pipeline is exactly as before.
options.spottingV2Hint: Builds cues from word timings instead of speech segments — fewer flashes and cut sentences
options.translationV2Hint: Translates the whole scene in one request, with punctuation and a reading-speed limit
options.renderV2Hint: Correct Hebrew glyph shaping, at most two lines, consistent placement at any resolution
